# javaabu/translatable

> Multilingual Eloquent models for Laravel. Attributes are read in the current locale, each locale is readable and writable as `title_dv`, and translations are stored as JSON on the row (IsJsonTranslatable) or as a row per locale (IsDbTranslatable). Ships Blade components (javaabu/forms v2) and Inertia React components (@javaabu/forms, through javaabu/manifest), and the contract other Javaabu packages use for optional translation support.

Paths are relative to this file. In a project, that's vendor/javaabu/translatable/.

## Rules

- Languages are rows of the `languages` table; only active ones can be translated into. Add them with `php artisan translatable:add-languages en dv`. The default locale (`translatable.default_locale`) must be one of them.
- Make a model translatable with `implements JsonTranslatable` + `use IsJsonTranslatable` (or `DbTranslatable` + `IsDbTranslatable`), list fields in `protected array $translatable`, and add `$table->jsonTranslatable()` (or `dbTranslatable()`) to its migration. Prefer JSON unless each language needs its own row, id or slug.
- Forms have one input per locale named `{field}_{locale}`, the default locale included (`title_en`, `title_dv`). Never invent other names.
- Validate with `Translatable::rules($model_or_class, $rules)`; save with `fill()`/`create()`/`update()` on the validated data. Suffixed attributes are written on `save()`; only `addTranslation()`/`addTranslations()` save immediately.
- Read with `$model->title` (current locale, falls back), `$model->title_dv` (no fallback by default), `$model->translate('title', 'dv', fallback: false)`, or `Translatable::values($model)` for every locale.
- In Blade use `<x-translatable::text>`, `textarea` or `field type="…"` for translatable fields, inside `<x-forms::form :model>`. In React use `TranslatableText`/`TranslatableTextarea`/`TranslatableField` under a `TranslatableProvider`.
- Routes whose locale comes from the URL use the `language` middleware and a `{language}` parameter; build links with `translate_route()` or `$model->url($action, $locale)`.
- Packages that support translatable optionally: `suggest` it, guard every call with `class_exists(\Javaabu\Translatable\Translatable::class) && Translatable::enabled()` / `supports()`, and follow docs/advanced-usage/for-package-authors.md. Don't import `@javaabu/translatable` from another package's React code.
- Dhivehi inputs get `dir="rtl"` and the Thaana keyboard automatically; use Thaana in tests of user-facing behaviour.
- In tests, use `Javaabu\Translatable\Testing\InteractsWithLanguages::setUpLanguages(['en', 'dv'])`.
